Implemented the fix in both javac and Eclipse `@StandardException` handlers.

- Generated no-args constructors now call `this((String) null, (Throwable) null)`.
- Generated message-only constructors now call `this(message, (Throwable) null)`.
- Added the corresponding typed-null helpers for javac and ECJ.

This prevents overload resolution from matching user-defined constructors such as `@AllArgsConstructor` when two non-primitive fields are present.

- `ant test.instance` — 416 tests, 0 failures
- `ant test.javacCurrent` — passed
- Only the two handler source files were modified; no test files changed.
